scripts.build: pnpm -C ../contracts run build && pnpm run build:tokens && pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc -p packages/frontend/tsconfig.json && vp build && node ./scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp lint packages/frontend --format unix && pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp fmt packages/frontend --check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C ../contracts run build && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc -p packages/frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit
